message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and at least one weekend day (Friday or Monday).  (If a holiday falls on a weekday, the nearest weekend day is added to create the long weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the federal holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario) | Family Day in Ontario was on Friday, Feb 20. |
| **Mar 4–6** | Family Day (British Columbia) | BC’s Family Day was on Friday, Mar 6. |
| **Apr 7–10** | Good Friday & Easter Monday | Good Friday (Apr 7) + Easter Monday (Apr 10) created a 4‑day stretch. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day was on Monday, May 22. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day was on Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving was on Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, Nov 13. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas Day was on Monday, Dec 25. |

### Province‑specific long weekends (not federal)

| Province | Holiday | Date(s) | Notes |
|----------|---------|---------|-------|
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Patrick’s Day | Feb 17–19 | St. Patrick’s Day is a statutory holiday in NL; the long weekend ran from Friday, Feb 17 to Sunday, Feb 19. |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • If you need to support all provinces, consider pulling the holiday data from the Canadian government’s “Public Holidays” API or the *Canadian Holiday Calendar* dataset.  
> • Remember that some holidays (e.g., Good Friday, Easter Monday) are **religious** and may not be observed in all provinces.  
> • For a clean UI, group the long weekends by month and highlight the holiday name.

Let me know if you’d like the data in a CSV/JSON format or if you need the same information for another year!
